summary: Constructed two minimal Node source files for one future original-evidence ARGPLAN helper call with bounded two-process capture, plus actual-flow checkpoint. Fixed root packet and independent packet SHA must supply final helper/core/test/codec/protocol/review/runner/wrapper pins; no future pins or admission packet were invented. Parent consumes exclusive fsynced token before NEW run directory/spawn; child independently rechecks packet/token and creates a separate exclusive child-start marker before dynamic helper import and at most one valid-enabled call. READY writes returned encodedBytes directly <=2MiB with independent digest checks; small receipts/raw streams are capped64KiB. Parent actually waits child close/exit/signal, retains stream prefixes/termination facts and distinguishes helper return/throw from subsequent output failure. No source execution/syntax/import/test/codec/evidence read occurred; root plus a different worker must review exact source and final repaired helper/tests before any run GO.

actualProspectiveFlow: Parent validates CLI/fixed packet SHA, exact source/protocol/review pins; no helper import or raw evidence.
Create fsynced exclusive tokens/<runId>.spent.json bound to packet/request/pins/reviews and wrapperPid; failed subsequent work does not unspend it.
Reserve NEW runs/<runId> and raw stream files; direct process.execPath spawn, shell:false, no inherited NODE_OPTIONS/NODE_PATH.
Child rechecks same fixed packet/pins/token/parent, creates exclusive child-started.json before helper import; reuse cannot call helper again.
Dynamic helper import then exactly one awaited buildOriginalEvidencePlan; attempted/returned/threw events reflect actual call boundary.
READY exact envelope/newPATH0/exact Uint8Array1..2MiB/independent returned SHA check; wx+fsync raw plan.wire.json without native decoding or whole-plan console dump.
Helper receipt <=64KiB separates returned helper from write/receipt errors. Receipt-write failure reports bounded event/first-error projection to raw stderr where possible.
Parent caps each raw stream64KiB, flags prefix-only and first failure, TERM then KILL2s, wall120s; awaits actual close event and records exit code/signal.
Parent independently rehashes opaque output wire and inventories known available files; empty raw streams valid; final exit metadata <=64KiB.
Root launcher separately observes wrapper exit/signal and hashes exit.json, which cannot contain its own hash.

limitsAndFailureContract.durableToken: wx file write+file fsync+token-directory fsync before child/helper work. Fsync/reservation failure stops; partial file stays consumed. This is host filesystem machinery, not universal storage/crash authentication.
limitsAndFailureContract.once: Exclusive parent token plus separate exclusive child-start marker; no retry/cleanup/overwrite/replacement route.
limitsAndFailureContract.capture: Exact stored raw prefix, received/written counts and prefixOnly/writeFailed flags. A failed write can leave a partial file absent from inventory; preserve directory/token. Missing receipt/exit after disk failure or abrupt host death remains missing/unknown.
limitsAndFailureContract.exit: actualChildExit.closeObserved/code/signal comes from Node child close, not helper return or intended exit. Wrapper own later exit/signal requires external launcher; wrapperIntendedExitCode is labeled intended.
limitsAndFailureContract.timeoutQualification: Operational120s wall timer then2s TERM grace/KILL attempt; no total CPU/RSS/OS kill-latency/descendant-tree certification. Reviewed helper must not spawn descendants.
limitsAndFailureContract.noBudgetConflation: Parent/child source-pin rereads and output hashes are outside helper8MiB evidence load count and future CV producer16MiB budget. No actual original tree/output cap passage or resource sufficiency claim.
limitsAndFailureContract.terminalNegative: Frozen-cap failure is useful terminal engineering evidence, no cap raise/rerun. Output repair never repeats helper.

reviewBoundary.unimplemented: No fabricated runner-test seam/packet or test file authored. Later synthetic runner/token/capture verification requires separately reviewed fixtures; never fabricate a ROOT_FINAL_GO packet to invoke original evidence during NONCV.
reviewBoundary.existingHolds: R2005 source-protocol acceptance does not approve this implementation, final helper or tests. All producer G1-G6 HOLD remain.
reviewBoundary.authorityLimits: Trusted independently supplied root packet digest/target review declarations; no cryptographic human-authorship detector. Source hashes/descriptor checks are at check-time, not host/ESM execution authentication or complete concurrent-replacement defense.
